newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nishimatsu Construction falls on ratings cut.
newsitem.headline: Nishimatsu Construction falls on ratings cut.

text.p: Nishimatsu Construction Co Ltd shares fell on Monday morning following a ratings cut, brokers said.
As of 0121 GMT, the shares were down 35 yen at 790, the fourth-largest percentage loser on the first section of the Toyo bourse.
Daiwa Securities brokers said on Monday that the Daiwa Institute of Research had downgraded Nishimatsu to a "B" rating from its previous "A".

In its three-grade rating system, the research institute assigns a "B" rating to issues whose values it sees moving within 10 percentage points in either direction of the Tokyo Stock Exchange's first-section TOPIX index over the next six months.
